verdict.rationale: Orb documents automatic invoice issuance, proration/minimums/maximums calculations, and revenue recognition, indicating invoices are generated and delivered automatically, but there is no explicit evidence of sequential invoice numbering, credit note generation, receipts, or custom fields/memos on invoices. missing for 10: sequential numbering guarantees, credit note issuance, receipt generation, custom fields/memo support on invoices, and independent confirmation of compliance formatting.
